The newest `Fix review:` is blocked: vacuous-test: zeroing the coordinator feed's sun regressor fails no check in tests/features.py, yet it moves the finder's harness P1 fix2.00 from 0.006/0.009/0.013 to 0.095/0.106/0.114. Then re-measure with the finder's harness at both ends. coordinator.py is shared with #2368 and #2411: keep your hunks to the vent-detector region the PR already touches.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. Toolchain is on PATH. Run heavy jobs in the background with Monitor. Run tests/entities.py with `env -u BASH_ENV`.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fixer.md and CLAUDE.md from origin/main and follow them exactly. Merge origin/main, never rebase. Re-execute steps 2-8 and re-take the body in full; answer every red check in `## Red checks`.
Return: push code to `handoff/r10-vent-detector` (fast-forward) and the body via tools/audit/seat/body_push.sh to `handoff-body/r10-vent-detector`. Push nothing else; do not open, edit, comment on or merge any PR. A fixer writes no delivery row. No host paths in any text. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it. End with CODE=<sha> BODY=<sha>.
